findings.text: Falsifier decidability is partial and honestly declared. falsifier.tier_1 requires non-meagerness of the extendible set, which the same leaf labels non_machine_checkable_step; the machine-checkable steps verify a supplied extension, not the class-level refutation. tier_2 is decidable but refutes only the strictly stronger 'forall data' statement (labelling_required: refutes_strengthening_only). There is therefore no decidable class-level falsifier, matching the suite's own ADJ-SEM-1. Not blocking: the schema declares the limit and provides decidable schema_falsifiers.
findings.falsifier: A decidable procedure that decides non-meagerness of the extendible set for the declared class, or a tier-1 restatement whose only non-decidable step is removed.

findings.text: Quantifier-domain coverage gap between the schema and the declared F0 text. D0 in the schema is a tagged disjoint union {smooth} union {(sobolev,s,delta)}, while the canonical F0 taxonomy's C0 conclusion quantifies only over 'admissible (s,delta)'. The supplement's data_class_freeze sanctions the smooth-with-decay default, so this is under-specification rather than contradiction, but check_taxonomy_consistency.py compares no quantifier-domain field (I reproduced CONSISTENT at current bytes), so a reader instantiating the class from the declared-F0 text alone would omit the smooth branch. Owner: F0/lead-formulation.
findings.falsifier: An F0 C0 conclusion text that explicitly quantifies over the same D0 tagged union as the schema, or a consistency checker that compares quantifier domains and still passes.

Independent read-only replication of the W06 semantic contract suite at current bytes: 32 mutants - structural 32/32 caught, semantic baseline 11/32, semantic hardened 32/32; no mutant escapes the adopted stages; the C0 schema is accepted by all three stages (supporting no class leakage). But the suite's three conforming_canonical pins are all stale, so the unmodified runner now exits 2 on integrity before producing a verdict; all 3 frozen controls are rejected by the structural stage on R22 and R28 (README records R28 only); and the WCC sibling schemas/af_wcc_vacuum.yaml is rejected by both semantic stages on R03 at current bytes. The suite is therefore not valid as current-revision calibration evidence (ADJ-CONTROL-STALENESS). C0 itself is clean in this replication.

findings.text: Assumption-completeness nit: the boundary convention for M' is not frozen. extension_predicate (c) requires M' to be a smooth connected 4-manifold and (f) uses int(M' minus iota(M)) without stating whether manifolds with non-empty boundary are admitted or excluded. Two careful readers can classify the same triple differently (an extension into a manifold-with-boundary counted or not). The schema freezes the adjacent conventions (smooth structure, iota regularity, future direction, no equation), so this one is conspicuous by omission.
findings.falsifier: Two recorded readings of the same extension triple that differ solely on whether non-empty boundary of M' is allowed; or a frozen clause 'partial M-prime is empty' (or its explicit negation).
